title: Bind every signed Kaji reply to the request it answers
goal: A captured reply cannot answer a later request: the client refuses a reply not signed for its own request nonce
acceptance: A committed test fails first: an epoch-push reply captured for one request is replayed to answer another and is refused
Reply signatures cover the request nonce; the decision states how an older peer is treated
The owner agreed the change to the signed reply: option A, 2026-11-25 (bases update together)
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real keys and device evidence remain private.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix (test/kaji-reply-binding.test.ts, 793d00c0)
escalation: Changes the signed Kaji reply: the owner agrees before work starts
Never weaken request signing or nonce replay checks to make progress

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 from B-121-T02 (stated): signing helper, both call paths, a replay test, decision text. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-26.
